 Janakpur Bolts Sign Kusal Perera for Nepal Premier League
 Ratopati
 October 26, 2026
 Read in Nepali
 Kathmandu. Janakpur Bolts have brought Sri Lankan explosive batter Kusal Perera into the team for the third edition of the Nepal Premier League.
 Left-handed aggressive batter Perera is known for his excellent performance in big tournaments and decisive moments. Perera, who has played international cricket in all three formats for Sri Lanka, has experience playing in various T-20 leagues around the world.
 According to Janakpur Bolts, Perera's arrival will further strengthen the team's batting lineup, and his aggressive style and experience are believed to greatly assist the team's journey to the title.
